transliteration: vibhāgadharmasaṃdehe dāyādānāṃ vinirṇaye jñātibhir bhāgalekhyaiś ca pṛthakkāryapravartanāt
sph_interpretive_translation: When doubt arises regarding the dharmic division of inheritance among heirs, resolution shall proceed through distinct procedural documentation by qualified kin and authorized scribes, ensuring separation of duties to uphold clarity and prevent conflict.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in documented procedural clarity aligned with familial dharmic roles
Causation is established through structured separation of administrative functions
Capacity-based responsibility assigns specific duties to qualified kin and record-keepers
Restoration logic requires prevention of conflict through procedural distinction
Consciousness alignment occurs when each actor fulfills their role without overlap or ambiguity
executable_legal_axioms: IF inheritance dispute EXISTS AND procedural documentation IS incomplete THEN assign distinct roles to qualified kin AND certified scribes FOR independent action
IF multiple parties claim overlapping authority THEN enforce functional segregation UNTIL resolution is stabilized
IF conflict risk exceeds threshold THEN mandate separate documentation channels BY lineage AND asset type
IF heir demonstrates capacity deficiency THEN initiate supervised partition process UNDER witness authority
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that disputes over inheritance must not rely solely on subjective claims but require clear procedural demarcation enforced through documented division by recognized authorities. The court ensures that no single individual holds concurrent control over both decision-making and recording, thereby preventing manipulation or misalignment with dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies conflict potential as rooted in undifferentiated authority. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential assignment of distinct roles—first identifying qualified agents, then delineating responsibilities, then executing documentation. Proportional responsibility lies in fulfilling assigned function without encroachment. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction arises through realignment, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate procedural role-mapping to isolate conflicting jurisdictions
Assign neutral scribes for parallel documentation under witness supervision
Re-establish heir integrity through witnessed affirmation of separated duties
Complete transactional closure via independent verification of all partitions
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: dharma prevails through ordered procedure, consciousness remains sovereign, and inheritance flows without friction. Conflict is resolved through structural clarity, not punitive consequence. Thus is Dharma restored.
